ontology.title: Reuters-21578 R(10) topics (native-task benchmark)
ontology.description: v2.1: v1 questions, with the v2 wording kept only for topics where it raised F1 on the 1,000-story training-split sample (earn 82.8->95.2, trade 59.1->76.1; runs jev-2a76a81657ecb662 vs jev-ec62663abf83cf8d). crude, interest, ship and wheat reverted to v1 (v2 lowered their F1). No test-split story was examined. v1 remains the pre-registered result.

topics.name: Reuters topics
topics.question: Which Reuters-21578 topics does the article cover?
topics.definition: The ten most frequent Reuters-21578 TOPICS categories (the R(10) benchmark). Flat and multi-label: each topic is decided independently.

topic.earn.name: Earnings and Earnings Forecasts
topic.earn.definition: Reuters-21578 TOPICS category 'earn' (Earnings and Earnings Forecasts).
topic.earn.yes_no_question: Does the article report a company's earnings, profits, losses or other financial results, or a forecast of them, or a dividend declaration or change, or a stock split?

topic.acq.name: Mergers/Acquisitions
topic.acq.yes_no_question: Does the article report a merger, acquisition or takeover, such as a proposed, agreed or completed purchase of a company, a business unit, or a stake in a company?

topic.money-fx.name: Money/Foreign Exchange
topic.money-fx.yes_no_question: Does the article concern money markets or foreign exchange, such as currency exchange rates, currency trading or intervention, or money-market conditions and liquidity?

topic.grain.name: Grain
topic.grain.yes_no_question: Does the article concern grain, such as wheat, corn, rice, barley, sorghum, oats or other cereal crops, including their production, trade, prices or supplies?

topic.crude.name: Crude Oil
topic.crude.yes_no_question: Does the article concern crude oil, such as oil prices, production, supply, exports, reserves or exploration?

topic.trade.name: Trade
topic.trade.yes_no_question: Is the article about international trade as an economic or policy matter, such as a country's trade balance, deficit or surplus, overall exports or imports, tariffs, quotas, or trade talks, disputes or agreements between countries? A single sale, tender or shipment of a commodity does not count.

topic.interest.name: Interest Rates
topic.interest.yes_no_question: Does the article concern interest rates, such as changes to official, lending, deposit or market interest rates?

topic.ship.name: Shipping
topic.ship.yes_no_question: Does the article concern shipping, such as merchant ships, ports, freight, maritime transport, or disruptions to shipping?

topic.wheat.name: Wheat
topic.wheat.yes_no_question: Does the article concern wheat, such as its production, trade, prices or supplies?

topic.corn.name: Corn
topic.corn.yes_no_question: Does the article concern corn (maize), such as its production, trade, prices or supplies?
